2302.text: Anger is a desire for revenge.
2302.notes: PARTIAL: only the quoted part was returned verbatim by the fetch. scborromeo.org mirror of the Vatican text; one vatican.va fetch makes it canonical. The paragraph goes on to vengeance ('to desire vengeance in order to do evil to someone who should be punished is illicit', per the Catechism; not returned verbatim). Cited for the vengeance callout line, Ch. 8.
